_comment: Public copy of the shipped config. Ships disarmed: dry_run true and template_approved false, with a placeholder identity. Nothing sends until all three are set deliberately. Outreach sender config. Going live needs THREE deliberate flips: dry_run:false AND template_approved:true AND real copy in the template (no [PLACEHOLDER]). Any one missing = no live send. See method/AUTOSEND.md.
_send_windows_note: dead when tz_scheduler:true (per-recipient local morning replaces it); kept for one-flag rollback
_breaker_note: The automatic halt ships disabled, with pre-send mailbox verification and the adaptive throttle as the controls instead. Bounces are still scanned and hard-bounced addresses are still suppressed. Set breaker_enabled true if you would rather have a hard stop.
_throttle_note: Ships disabled, with mailbox verification running pre-send as the control instead. Note what that means: with breaker_enabled false and this false, there is no bounce-rate-driven brake, and STOP/HALT are the only stops. Tiers live in THROTTLE_TIERS in send_outreach.py, so re-enabling is one key. Decide deliberately - an unbraked cold stream is how a sending domain gets burned.
_require_verified_note: When the breaker and the throttle are both off, verification is the only bounce control, so an unverified row must not be sendable - otherwise 'verification is the control' is a claim with nothing behind it.
_verify_note: Bouncer mailbox verification, run by pipeline/verify_queue.py as its own chain step BEFORE the send. Ships false: do the one-off pass over the existing queue by hand and review it before flipping this true (method/VERIFY-INTEGRATION.md §7). Needs BOUNCER_API_KEY in ~/.config/graduate-signals/verify.env, mode 600. Only 'undeliverable' is terminal; risky / unknown / deliverable-on-an-accept-all-domain are recorded and stay sendable so the harder rules get set from this campaign's own bounce outcomes. No verify_cull_esps here: this worklist has no esp column (GitHub sourcing yields personal/freemail, not corporate gateways).
_daily_cap_note: Flat cap, no ramp, on the assumption the sending inbox is already warmed. Lower it after any bounce spike and raise it back deliberately; a cap restored on the same day as an incident is not a decision, it is a reflex.
